{{Top}}
'''Orbital Assembly Facility 7''', '''Orbital 7''' for short, was an assembly facility for the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. It produced many ships, including the infamous [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], part of the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] line. The facility was comprised of several assembly lines which produced components, and another line which assembled the components into the final ship.
